name: Poster Persistence System
description: Cross-cutting system that stores, retrieves, and reconciles saved poster state across reloads and devices.
technical_role: Manages local persistence, cache rehydration, and sync reconciliation for saved poster metadata.
semantic_role: Keeps saved artwork reliably available when the user expects it.

evidence.description: List UI depends on the sync-aware hook owned by this system.
Multiple features rely on the same persistence and rehydration logic, justifying a system boundary.

notes: This system was added in Phase 2C because a shared capability explains behavior across features better than component-level file grouping.

name: User Authentication
description: Cross-cutting system for login, session handling, and authenticated requests.
technical_role: Manages credentials, token refresh, and authenticated API transport.
semantic_role: Lets recognized users access personalized content reliably.

evidence.description: Poster persistence often runs within an authenticated context.
